# Contraste

> Contraste is a small human and AI team doing verification-first public research. We track how AI capability spreads, check claims against the record, and publish the evidence, including our corrections. Tagline: "AI claims, checked against the record. / Afirmaciones sobre IA, contrastadas contra el registro."

## How to read this publication

Every claim Contraste handles carries one of three labels, always in words:
- PROVEN / COMPROBADO: the cited evidence establishes the specific finding stated, and is cited with source and date.
- INFERENCE / INFERENCIA: a conclusion drawn from proven claims, published as inference.
- UNVERIFIED / NO VERIFICADO: no checkable record yet; published as unverified or not at all.

Corrections are published in the open within 48 hours, in the corrections register and on the affected work. Nothing is edited silently.

## Site map

- / : Home. Mission, the verification standard, the ledger, the capability timeline, the corrections register, about.
- The Ledger: case files stating claim, record, verdict, sources, limitations, dates.
- The Capability Timeline: separates announced, demonstrated, and independently verified AI capability.
